observed.description: Four 1 px dark strokes forming a #; no coloured core.
observed.lumaNote: Fits black at alpha 230 blended in linear light; a reading from pixel values, not a colour-managed measurement.

alphaAnalysis.method: Orchestrator re-analysis (2026-10-02) of the screenshot pixel values: effective alpha of black = 1 - observed / background, in linear light (sRGB decoded), for stroke pixels and for the four stroke crossings. A reading from 8-bit pixel values, not a colour-managed measurement.
alphaAnalysis.conclusion: Strokes fit one black blend at the crosshair opacity; crossings fit two. Each old element drew its own outline rect, so overlapping outlines blended twice. The new renderer composites the outline once per pixel, so the four crossing pixels of the issue #11 # are slightly darker in the old game (accepted nuance, ADR-0015).

modelComparison.result: Rows match exactly. Columns are offset by +3 px in x (observed minus predicted); the cause is unexplained (equal to floor(7/2) under the truncation width model).
